title: Does the agent team justify its cost?
description: Compare C0 fixed workflow, C1 single agent with all tools, and C2 specialist team under the same model, tools, and budget. Preserve safety and approval controls in every configuration.
harness: eval/harness/e1_runner.py; offline wiring check: python scripts/evaluate_e1_dry_run.py (scripted model; NOT a result).
development_result: gpt-4.1-mini, 31 dev cases x3 repeats, 0 errors: C0/C1/C2 each 31/31 every repeat; model calls/case C1 2.23 vs C2 2.45; tokens/case 670 vs 706; median latency ~2.05 s vs ~2.2 s. Development only; see docs/ROLE3_CHANGES_WALKTHROUGH.md.
blocker: Requires frozen Phase 5 agents/guardrails and a protected held-out set.
